deliverables: Frontend maintenance and cross-platform development for web, browser extension, iOS, Android, and beta channels
Backend infrastructure and operations including nodes, DBSync indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, monitoring, and incident response
User support through Discord ticketing, Telegram, public channels, ecosystem support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Governance tooling enhancements including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Periodic independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics in February 2027 and August 2027
Introduction of paid Eternl Pro plans and semiannual treasury repayment or donation assessments
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements while Eternl introduces paid Pro plans intended to replace treasury support.

claims.claim: Eternl asks for ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 in annual operating costs for August 2026 through July 2027.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs, and about 5,500 Pro users would fully cover the stated $420,000 annual cost.
After withdrawal, Eternl says it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, place it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The audits allocation is for independent audits of treasury fund use and oversight metrics, not technical security audits, with audits planned for February 2027 and August 2027 by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team.

Eternl commits to semiannual repayment assessments where surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income above $420,000 would be repaid until $420,000 worth of Ada has been returned, followed by possible additional donations capped at $210,000 worth of Ada.
Eternl says 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
Eternl states it has provided multi-platform Cardano access with basically zero downtime for over five years.
Eternl states its main UI will not be open-source, though some libraries used in Eternl will be published through the npm registry.

If treasury funding is not approved and paid plans do not sell enough licenses beyond August, Eternl says it may let developers go, scale down to essential maintenance, shift focus outside Cardano, remove the free option, and reduce support and infrastructure resilience.

summary: The proposal requests ₳2,350,000 for 12 months of Eternl operations, with stated cost controls, conversion and refund mechanics, audit and reporting commitments, and a path toward Pro-plan sustainability, but several key adoption, transaction-share, uptime, and non-funding-impact claims are asserted without evidence in the anchor text.
